ammonia.reason: Low NH3 from amino acid deamination during natural-rind proteolysis, no washed-rind putrescine pathway.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole plus sheep lanolin branched fatty acids transferred from ewe milk and pasture.

bitter.reason: Few residual hydrophobic peptides from alpha-s1-casein, mostly cleared by LAB peptidases.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, no methyl-ketone 2-heptanone/2-nonanone formation.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard between residual galactose and lysine on heating due to low residual sugar.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl and acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus/Leuconostoc in high-fat ewe milk.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butanoic and hexanoic acids from milk lipase plus LAB esterase lipolysis of ewe triglycerides.

creaminess.reason: High 38% fat lubricates mouthfeel despite firm pressed paste.

crumbliness.reason: Pressed semi-hard paste deforms before fracturing, not granular like long-aged grana.

firmness.reason: Pressed low-moisture rennet gel with calcium-phosphate crosslinked casein after 5 months.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine transamination plus pasture terpenes.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate and ethyl hexanoate from LAB esterase esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Low caproic/caprylic waxy notes; ewe milk lacks intense goat 4-ethyloctanoic character.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 2-methylpropanal and 3-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine catabolism during ripening.

melt.reason: pH 5.3 demineralized paracasein network flows on heating while retaining some structure.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol from linoleic acid oxidation, no surface mold to amplify it.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from coalescing large ewe-milk fat globules on melting.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked make with no wood-smoke phenols guaiacol/syringol deposition.

sour_vinegar.reason: L-lactic plus trace acetic from lactose fermentation by starter LAB, buffered at pH 5.3.

stretch.reason: Rennet-coagulated non-pasta-filata mesh lacks aligned fibers for stretching.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal methionine-derived sulfides; curd not high-heated so no cooked-milk H2S.

sweet.reason: Sweet amino acids proline/alanine plus glycerol and diacetyl balancing acidity in ewe matrix.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from chymosin and LAB peptidase proteolysis over months.
